sections.body:
## People ready to work

Contractors often need extra height technicians for a short period — shutdowns, seasonal work, or urgent projects. We supply technicians holding Kemnaker certificates and K3 licences at the grade you need, from [TKPK Level 1](/en/tkpk-level-1-training/) to [TKPK Level 3](/en/tkpk-level-3-training/) supervisors, plus [TKBT](/en/tkbt-level-1-training/) workers for structural work.

## Documents in place before mobilisation

Copies of each technician’s certificate and licence, personal details, and fitness statement are handed over before mobilisation, so induction on your site is quick.

## Flexible to the project

Numbers, duration, and team make-up (including supervisors) are matched to the scope. Technicians can work under your supervisor or as a complete team with an RAC supervisor.

columns.title: Scope of work
items: TKPK Level 1 and 2 rope access technicians
Complete teams with a supervisor and rescue plan

columns.title: What you receive
items: Copies of competency and medical documents

sections.title: Four steps from survey to report

items.title: 1. Survey & quotation
items.text: We review the site or your photos and drawings, then send the scope, method, schedule, and a written quotation.

items.title: 2. Work plan & permits
items.text: A risk assessment, method statement, and rescue plan are prepared before work starts; permits are arranged with the site manager.

items.title: 3. Delivery
items.text: A team of Kemnaker-certified technicians works with a supervisor on site; the area below the work zone is secured.

items.title: 4. Report & handover
items.text: Before-and-after photos and a work report are handed over with recommendations for the next maintenance cycle.

items.a: It depends on numbers, certification grade, and location. In Greater Jakarta, mobilisation can usually be arranged within days of agreement.

items.q: Do technicians bring their own equipment?
items.a: Technicians arrive with inspected PPE and personal equipment. Project-specific equipment is agreed in the quotation.
Yes, with transport and accommodation agreed in advance.

sections.title: Tell us about the job
sections.text: Send the location, the type of building or asset, and your target dates. We reply with a written quotation, usually the same working day.
